verdict.rationale: Brex documents automatic receipt matching: uploaded receipts are matched to existing expenses. Its AI assistants are claimed to fetch receipts, and a community comment mentions auto-generated receipts. However, nothing shows e-receipts being pulled from specific integrations, or nudges limited to receipts that are genuinely missing; the review agent's follow-ups are framed around compliance generally. missing for 10: documented e-receipt ingestion from named integrations (e.g. email or vendor connectors), evidence of a missing-receipt-only nudge mechanism, independent hands-on corroboration of match accuracy.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
